title: Trace of the input-copy machine
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb N$, let $x$ be a finite input word, choose a work-tape index $i<k$, and let $d$ be a configuration of the input-copy machine. Suppose $d$ is in the sweep state and its input head is at position $1$. For every $t\in\mathbb N$, the configuration after $t$ steps is the piecewise trace that equals the forward scan configuration at time $t$ for $t\le |x|$, the return configuration indexed by $2|x|+1-t$ for $|x|<t\le 2|x|+1$, and the designated done configuration for $t>2|x|+1$.
